decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The EV charging bypass would appear unduly prominent when in use and appear incongruent with the character and appearance of the street scene, and would harm the character of the host dwelling contrary to MLP (2024) Policies D12.3 and D12.4.
Reason : 2 - The EV charger would represent an incongruous structure when viewed from  no. 49 Cecil Road, harming the outlook of this property contrary to MLP Policy D12.3.
Reason : 3 - The proposed development would pose an undue risk to highway safety contrary to MLP (2024) Policy T16.3.

Reason : 4 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:

"	The application was considered to be fundamentally contrary to the provisions of the Development Plan and the NPPF, and there were not considered to be any solutions to resolve this conflict.
description:
To support the transition to zero emissions, adoption of fully Electric is a key objective and requirement for many households. This household has been running a lower emission Plug-In Hybrid EV for many years and has now ordered a fully Electric EV for full zero emission transport. The ability to charge the vehicle in a cost effective and reliable manner is an essential requirement to this transition.

The proposed works are to install a Pavement Bypass charging solution and EV Home Charger.

The Pavement Bypass solution is an innovative above pavement cable carrier that safely supports a charging cable directly from inside the property boundary, above the pavement and down to the cars EV charging port. 

It eliminates all trip hazards and requires absolutely no pavement updates or modifications. The construction of the device is simple and cost effective.

The Pavement Bypass solution is also fully foldable and removable, and expectation of planning permission will be the folding and removal of the device whenever it is not used for charging. This leaves no visible sign of the device from the pavement and only a small mount behind the boundary wall – not visible from the street.

The EV Home charger will be a professionally installed home charger supplied and fitted to the exterior of the house and located behind foliage to minimize visual impact from the street.
